managedFiles.v1: Never prune from v1 ownership claims; use recorded hashes only to detect edits at paths that overlap the new package.
managedFiles.v2: Treat recorded hashes as the previous installed package baseline and migrate to source-owned v3 hashes.
managedFiles.v3: Store package source hashes separately from installed overrides and report missing or changed files.

nativeSkillSync.unversionedInstall: Compare with the backed-up previous package when available; otherwise preserve differing destinations as user customizations and save the upstream copy for review.
nativeSkillSync.v1: Record source and installed tree hashes per native skill; update only unchanged managed trees and preserve custom trees.

skillsRouter.strategy: Install the current packaged router. Preserve a user-modified router as an override and save the incoming package version beside the rollback snapshot for review.

skillsManifest.strategy: Validate the current packaged manifest before swap; preserve modified local manifests as overrides and retain the incoming package copy for review.

steps.operation: Add schemaVersion while preserving all existing keys and values.

config.unknownFutureVersion: Fail closed before publishing the staged update.
